text: I'm so sorry to message this late, I know you must be really busy. My daughter is 7 months old and her temperature is 38.7°C. Her eczema has flared up as well, the dry patches on her arms and behind her knees are really bad and she keeps trying to scratch them. Her nappies are wet like normal so I think she's getting enough milk. I wasn't sure how much paracetamol or ibuprofen I'm allowed to give a baby her age, I didn't want to guess and get it wrong. Sorry again for bothering you.
